title: The Visual Studio 12 2013 generator is removed
summary: CMake 3.31 removed the Visual Studio 12 2013 generator. Projects and presets that still name that generator cannot configure on CMake 3.31 or newer. CMake 3.31.0 was published on 2024-11-06.
replacement: A still-supported Visual Studio generator, such as Visual Studio 17 2022

sources.title: CMake 3.31 release notes (Visual Studio 12 2013 generator removed)

constraints: Update CMake presets, CI matrix generator names, and documented configure commands together so every surface names the same supported generator.

steps.title: Replace the Visual Studio 12 2013 generator
steps.instructions: Change every reported generator name from Visual Studio 12 2013 to a supported Visual Studio generator installed on the build hosts.

verification.purpose: Configure with a supported Visual Studio generator.
